paite: TOUPA aw, heh in hon tai ke’nla; thangpai in hon sawi sam ke'n.
heading: David La / Gimthuaktu Thumna
english: A Psalm by David, for a memorial. Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.

paite: Na thalte ka sa ah atal a, na khut ka tung ah atu bukbuk ngal a.
english: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.

paite: Na lung hihlouhna ziak in ka sa ah dam lai himhim a-om kei a; ka thulimlouhna ziak in ka guhte ah dam lai a-om kei hi.
english: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.

paite: Ka thulimlouhnate'n ka lu atummang a, puakgiktak, ka puak zoh vual louh ahi.
english: For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.

paite: Ka haina ziak in ka liamnate uih in anamse zouta hi.
english: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt because of my foolishness.

paite: Ka chi ana a, ka kun ngiungiau a; nitum in lungkham in ka mau den hi.
english: I am in pain and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long.

paite: Ka kawng a lum huthut vek a; ka sa ah leng dam lai a-om kei hi.
english: For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.

paite: Ka bah a, ka sidup keihkuih a; ka lungtang noplouhna ziak in ka thum hithit hi.
english: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.

paite: TOUPA aw, ka deihlam tengteng na thei a; ka thumnate nang a pan sel ahi kei hi.
english: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.

paite: Ka lungphu kisai in hatna ka nei kei a; ka mit vakna in hon paimangsanta hi.
english: My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.

paite: Hon itte leh ka lawmte ka natna lak ah akihuikhia ua; ka sanggamte leng gamlapi ah adingh uhi.
english: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.

paite: Ka hinna hihmang tum a zongte'n hon matna ding un thang akam ua; ka siatna ding zongte'n leng thuhoih loutakte agen nak uhi; nitum in khemna thute angaihtuah uhi.
english: They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all day long.

paite: Himahleh kei tuh nangong bang in za lou in ka om a; pau theiloumi kam ka ngei lou bang in ka om hi.
english: But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear. I am as a mute man who doesn’t open his mouth.

paite: Ahi, mi pau za lou, akam a taihilhna pawt ngei lou bang in ka om hi.
english: Yes, I am as a man who doesn’t hear, in whose mouth are no reproofs.

paite: TOUPA aw, nangmah ka hon lamen ngal a; TOUPA ka Pathian aw, nang na hon dawng hi.
english: For I hope in you, Yahweh. You will answer, Lord my God.

paite: Huchi lou in zaw hon otsan ding a, ka khe ateutak in ka tung ah akihihlian kha ding uh, ka chi ahi.
english: For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”

paite: Ka puk dekdek ngal a, ka lungngaihna leng ka ma ah a-om gige hi.
english: For I am ready to fall. My pain is continually before me.

paite: Ka thulimlouhna ka pulak ding a; ka khelhna ziak in lungngai in ka om ding hi.
english: For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.

paite: Himahleh hon doute ahalh ua, ahat uhi; dikloupi a hon hote kilawmloupi in apung ua.
english: But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.

paite: Thil hoih thil gilou a thukte thil hoih ka delh ziak in hon doute ahi uhi.
english: They who give evil for good are also adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.

paite: TOUPA aw, hon paisan ke'nla; ka Pathian aw, hon gamlat mahmah ke'n.
english: Don’t forsake me, Yahweh. My God, don’t be far from me.

paite: TOUPA ka hondampa aw, hon panpih ding in, kin meng in.
english: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.
